tfidf.text_scope: all supplied text; names retained in primary analysis

method.text_graph: union of each article’s 8 highest-positive-cosine neighbors; cosine edge weights
method.communities: Louvain, resolution=1, seed=7; weighted text graph, unweighted undirected link graph
method.network_distance: shortest paths after symmetrizing links; disconnected pairs have null distance
method.layout: categorical community lanes: x deterministic seeded jitter, y network membership, z text membership; not a metric embedding
method.name_check: remove alphabetic words capitalized in more than half their occurrences; refit IDF and L2 norm
